sloka: दृष्ट्वा चाप्रकृतिस्थां तामप्रहृष्टामचेतनाम् ।पिता दुहितरं वाक्यं किमेतदिति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.५८.१७ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā cāprakṛtisthāṁ tāmaprahṛṣṭāmacetanām ।pitā duhitaraṁ vākyaṁ kimetaditi cābravīt ।। 7.58.17 ॥

translations.english: And having seen her in a disturbed, unhappy, and distraught state, the father spoke to his daughter, asking, "What is this?"
